svg.aria-label: Dynamics identified from 150 noisy transitions. Each left cell is fitted minus true coefficient on reference scales 1 m, 1 m/s, and 1 m/s², at a 0.2-second interval. The right panel shows actual position–velocity trajectories, with a star at the stationary target. Error against noise-free truth on 50 independent inputs is reported in the text.
